title: The Little Waking Branch
old_p1: One quiet day Heavenly Father asked Jeremiah a question. 'Jeremiah, what do you see?'
Jeremiah looked, and then he looked again. 'I see a branch from an almond tree,' he said.
The almond tree is the very first tree to wake up in spring. While the other trees are still sleeping, it opens white blossoms like little stars.
old_p2: 'Thou hast well seen,' Heavenly Father told him. 'I will hurry to do the thing that I have promised.'
Heavenly Father never forgets a promise. When He says a thing, He is already watching over it, the way He is watching over you tonight.
p1: One day Heavenly Father asked Jeremiah a question. “Jeremiah, what do you see?”
Jeremiah looked. “I see a branch from an almond tree,” he said.

The almond tree is the first tree to wake up in the spring. While the other trees are still bare, it opens white flowers like little stars. In Jeremiah’s language, the almond tree’s name sounds like the word for “watching.”
p2: “You have seen well,” Heavenly Father said. “I am watching over My word, to make it happen.” That means Heavenly Father is awake and watching, like the almond tree, ready to keep every promise.
Heavenly Father never forgets a promise. When He says a thing, He is already watching over it, the way He is watching over you tonight.

stone_name: That wide-awake, look-again feeling is called wonder. Your mind might think, “Wait, what is that?” Your body might lean in closer, with big eyes and a held breath.
